evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.
Does K2_C0001 exhibit a coherent, interpretable mutation phenotype that distinguishes it as a biologically meaningful unit?
Does K2_C0002 exhibit a coherent, interpretable mutation phenotype that distinguishes it as a biologically meaningful unit?
Does the K2_C0001/K2_C0002 boundary show consistent cross-modal representation supporting preservation of two independent units rather than a merge-compatible continuum?

actions.reason: K2_C0001 has an interpretable WXS phenotype (VHL/PBRM1 depletion, BAP1 enrichment; ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:e9f462ede3), but its exact-set membership is broadly unsupported: three of four native geometries (CT -0.036, WSI -0.083, WXS -0.069) show negative silhouettes with substantial negative fractions, and within-versus-between contrasts are small in every modality (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:e9f462ede3). Its only decision-relevant boundary, to K2_C0002, is weakly represented across all four views (silhouettes 0.013-0.091, negative fractions 26-46%) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:fbf65f89cc), and the pair's union structure is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1) with high normalized-cut cost (0.7733), i.e. merge-compatible rather than boundary-preserving (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:fbf65f89cc). Measured site and CT acquisition factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the K2_C0001 signal (tissue_source_site V=0.434, ct_phase V=0.316, ct_scanner_model V=0.310; ER:...confounder_association:set:e9f462ede3), and no persistence-after-adjustment evidence limits them. With membership broadly unsupported, the sole relevant boundary weak and merge-compatible, and no supported split, the candidate lacks defensible independent discovery value.

K2_C0002 has an interpretable WXS phenotype (VHL/PBRM1 enrichment, BAP1 depletion; ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:eba7fa9609), but its membership representation is only weak and coherent at best: all four native views show small positive silhouettes (CT 0.069, WSI 0.204, RNA 0.096, WXS 0.275) with small within-versus-between contrasts (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:eba7fa9609). Its only decision-relevant boundary, to K2_C0001, is weakly represented across all four views (silhouettes 0.013-0.091, negative fractions 26-46%) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:fbf65f89cc), and the pair's union structure is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1) with high normalized-cut cost (0.7733), i.e. merge-compatible rather than boundary-preserving (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:fbf65f89cc). The same measured site and CT acquisition factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the K2_C0002 signal (tissue_source_site V=0.434, ct_phase V=0.316, ct_scanner_model V=0.310; ER:...confounder_association:set:eba7fa9609), with no persistence-after-adjustment evidence. With weak membership support, a weak merge-compatible sole boundary, and no supported split, the candidate lacks defensible independent discovery value.
